interruption.whatWorked: The arm-level tolerance landed: the lane ran both arms to completion and RECORDED the model arm as unreportable instead of dying with it. This is the first attempt that produced a lane report at all.
interruption.error: refusing to publish an unreportable model arm: the model arm did not finish: model role interpret_residual_evidence produced output the domain refuses: an assessment may not declare producedBy; this layer stamps provenance
interruption.theFindingThisExposes: The reference model produced an assessment carrying `producedBy`, and the domain refused it because provenance is stamped by trusted code and never supplied by the model. The refusal is CORRECT and is one of the architecture's stated invariants. It is also real model-quality evidence: over this corpus the reference model produces output the domain refuses in at least two distinct ways — unparseable JSON on one record (attempt 587842baeabb) and a forbidden provenance field here.
interruption.whyTheRecordWasStillLost: This command's publish callback THREW on an unreportable arm, copied from the diagnostic sibling where that is correct. Here it destroyed the one artifact the protocol exists to produce. Fixed: a skipped publication is recorded as absent-with-a-reason and the record is completed.
interruption.whyThisIsNotVoided: The model executed against hold-out scenarios.
